description: Create packages/content (seed data stub) and packages/game-engine (pure logic stub) as placeholder packages. These will be populated in future milestones but need to exist in the monorepo structure now.
steps: Create packages/content/package.json with name @orbit/content, type: module, main: ./dist/index.js, scripts: build (tsc), test (vitest)
Create packages/content/README.md explaining versioned seed-data approach: daily questions, letter stationery, companion species, game content will live here as typed JSON with schemas
Create packages/content/src/index.ts with comment: '// Future: export daily questions, stationery, etc. Versioned seed data lives here.'
Create packages/content/src/__tests__/index.test.ts with basic import test verifying package loads without error
Create packages/game-engine/package.json with name @orbit/game-engine, type: module, main: ./dist/index.js, scripts: build (tsc), test (vitest)
Create packages/game-engine/README.md with GameEngine interface contract: deterministic pure functions, injectable clock (never Date.now()), no side effects, all game logic testable in isolation
Create packages/game-engine/src/index.ts with placeholder: `export interface GameEngine { /* Future: scoring, reveal gating, etc. */ }` and comment explaining design principles
Create packages/game-engine/src/__tests__/index.test.ts with basic import test verifying GameEngine interface is exported
acceptance_criteria: Both packages build successfully with TypeScript
README files clearly document the intended purpose and design principles
Packages are importable by other workspace packages
verification: Run `pnpm --filter @orbit/content build` and `pnpm --filter @orbit/game-engine build` - both succeed
Run `pnpm --filter @orbit/content test` and `pnpm --filter @orbit/game-engine test` - all tests pass
Run `pnpm build` from root and confirm both packages compile
findings: Successfully created @orbit/content and @orbit/game-engine as placeholder packages. Both packages compile cleanly, export stub index files, and have passing tests (2 tests for content, 5 tests for game-engine). READMEs document design principles: @orbit/content will contain versioned, schema-validated, localized seed data (daily questions, stationery, etc.), while @orbit/game-engine will contain pure, deterministic, side-effect-free game logic with injectable clock for testability. Tests verify package loading, version constants, and demonstrate the injectable clock pattern for game-engine. All Turborepo pipelines (build, test, type-check) pass successfully. Packages are ready to be populated in future milestones (Milestone 2 for content, Milestone 3 for game-engine).
